freeze_rule: Eligibility/exclusion is decided before protected outcomes of the candidate batch. This ledger may append future attempts but may not retroactively admit an excluded world after seeing its result.

historical_not_eligible.group: all worlds visible before S2G-V1 freeze

historical_not_eligible.reason: the C3 runs were registered/launched before S2G-V1 was frozen; later outcome visibility cannot make them prospective

post_freeze_candidates.reason: v6.3 performs protected-lifetime re-mining/recombination and can change its library/developmental geometry after protected execution starts. S2G-V1's frozen predictor is computed once from pre-target chosen-library/validation geometry and contains no state variable for later reminting/recombination. Counting ABC-v6.3 would therefore test an omitted dynamic-morphology object, not the frozen V1 map.
post_freeze_candidates.allowed_use: C3/K2 assay only; may motivate a separately frozen S2G-V2 after the complete C3b outcome batch, never backfilled into V1

required: fresh world first executed after S2G-V1 freeze
pre-target development+validation produces chosen library, T, D, beta_D and validation b_i/d_i/g_i rows

the protected arm's proposal geometry is governed by that frozen controller/library state for the scored world, aside from the already specified liveness fallback; no new library/miner/update mechanism during protected target execution
protected per-target rank_0 and rank_H receipt is available for every verified target
world is independent under the existing lane definition

next_eligible_source: future fresh fixed-controller/single-development-state worlds executed after freeze; do not redesign the world family to favor the predictor
